details.method: Run static checks for the complete candidate diff against the observed target main, and require the whole-PR CI result for the exact signed head; an identical-tree signature commit can have a passing empty-diff branch run. When any hook rewrites source, rerun interacting format/include checks to a stable source digest before signing.
details.when: The writer signs a same-tree delivery commit and CI scopes checks by changed files.
details.counterexample: A branch build that explicitly checks the full target diff can be sufficient for that scope; compiler-only and empty signature diffs cannot establish whole-PR static validation.
details.trial_plan: For the corrected candidate, run clang-format dry-run, include validation and another clang dry-run across the full target diff; require unchanged source hashes and exact signed-head whole-PR CI pass. Retain both earlier CI failures and verify target main separately.
